answer: Resist Sybils by pricing identity creation: every new agent must lock a rising bond and burn a non-refundable challenge fee before it can mine or grade. One honest node pays once; a vine of clones spanning an island of niches must refill that bond each time, draining an ocean of capital while panels slash coordinated low-effort answers. Attacker cost scales with count, so mass forging loses to a single established account.
